name: Bakbakkar
title: Levite in Jerusalem after the exile
summary: Bakbakkar was a Levite mentioned in 1 Chronicles among those who settled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile. He belonged to the Levitical line and played a role in rebuilding religious life in Jerusalem. He is mentioned only once in the Bible, in a genealogy of returning Levites.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among the Levites in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Bakbakkar is listed among the Levites who settled in Jerusalem after returning from the Babylonian exile. He is mentioned in a list along with other Levites such as Heresh, Galal and Mattaniah.

keyEvents.title: Rebuilding of religious life
keyEvents.description: As one of the Levites who returned to Jerusalem, Bakbakkar contributed to restoring temple service and religious life after the exile.

keyEvents.title: The Service of the Levites in the Temple
keyEvents.description: Bakbakkar was part of the group of Levites who were given responsibility for various services in the rebuilt temple in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Settling in Jerusalem after the Exile
keyEvents.description: After the Babylonian captivity, many Israelites returned to their cities, and the Levites, including Bakbakkar, settled in Jerusalem to serve at the temple.
